declaration.argument: The campaign's adaptive-operator-selection arm runs on an ordered-release pool: it may draw up to two batches ahead of the newest credited batch while workers would otherwise go without work. Run ids per batch, the controller random draws per run id, per-run seeds, credit order and the once-per-batch bandit recompute are held; with one worker nothing is drawn ahead, and one-thread identity on VR, Mencius and a caps-engaged 100,000-run VR session read identical. At 30 threads a batch drawn ahead picks operators and parents from a bandit up to two recomputes and a population up to 120 insertions stale, so the search is declared affected and owes the lite grader's non-inferiority reading with an AOS-arm hand reading beside it.
